description: NaNi₂H₃(SeO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra and corners with six SeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.56 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four SeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.14 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.13 Å) and one longer (1.33 Å) H-O bond length. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-70°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.72 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-71°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.72 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ni and two H atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONi₂H₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Ni and two H atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONi₂H₂ tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ni and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ni and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one Se atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one Se atom.
